item.title: Rallying Cry – June 12, 2026
item.description: From rugby legends to quiet supersonic planes, today’s good news includes Sinfield, Blackman, and Donaldson leading the honors list, David Beckham getting his Hollywood star, and Chile’s bold steps to fight child obesity—plus, Canada’s generous aid pledge and a record-breaking T20 win for England!
